# Extracted video editor source

Source: ArtCraft, https://github.com/storytold/artcraft
Snapshot: 1f969a9224934a55417daf10359a6fb1458b63f4

`artcraft-video-editor/` contains the upstream React video-editor package from `frontend/libs/components/video-editor/`. `source-example/PageVideoEditor.tsx` is the app host integration example. The app should preserve the upstream licenses and notices in this folder. The extracted package is retained as source/reference; any adaptation should be clearly identified and attributed.
